about: M4 manual review of address -> jurisdiction resolution. Overrides are applied by scripts/resolve_jurisdictions.py only if their original_census_evidence still matches and every census_verification query returns exactly one Census candidate inside an incorporated place that maps to the corrected jurisdiction. Notes never change a result. Not legal advice.
reviewer: M4 manual review (Claude Code session), pending confirmation by the project owner

overrides.authoritative_reason: Census evidence. The source street '397 05TH AV' uses a zero-padded ordinal (DataSF formatting) that the Census matcher does not parse. The reviewer query removes only the leading zero ('397 5TH AV'), with the same city and state and no ZIP (none in the source); Census matches it to exactly one address inside San Francisco city (see verification_result).
overrides.reviewer_note: Only the zero padding was removed; the suffix 'AV' and every other character are as in the source.

overrides.authoritative_reason: Census evidence. The source '600 JACKSON/601 HARRISON' names two street frontages of one parcel, which the Census matcher cannot parse as one address. Each frontage, exactly as written in the source (split at '/', nothing added), with the source city, state and ZIP, is matched by Census to exactly one address, and both lie inside Hoboken city (see verification_result).
overrides.reviewer_note: Both frontages agree; no suffix or number was invented.

overrides.authoritative_reason: Census evidence. Census misread the decimal range '322-322.5' as house number 5, giving two '5 WESTERN AVE' candidates on either side of the Charles River (Boston city and Cambridge city), so no jurisdiction was reported. The reviewer query is the first number of the source's own range, '322 Western Ave', with the source city and state; Census matches it to exactly one address inside Cambridge city (see verification_result). This is the range-endpoint reading that Census applies by itself to the other ranged addresses.
overrides.reviewer_note: Western Ave crosses from Cambridge into Boston (Allston); the tied candidates were at the wrong house number, so the disagreement was not real evidence of a Boston location.

target_notes.non_exact_match: Reviewed every Non_Exact match (164). For the 150 resolved ones, the differences are a range endpoint, a ZIP, the Census mailing city, ordinal spelling, a one-sided suffix or a unit designator only, and in each case the Census place is the city named by the source row (Boston neighborhoods inside Boston city). The other 14 are review_required and have their own notes.
target_notes.postal_city_differs_from_legal_jurisdict: Reviewed all 33 rows (32 Boston neighborhood names, 1 San Ysidro): 32 resolved, A0245 review_required for a street token. In each, the Census matched address uses the same postal name, and the Census place is Boston city or San Diego city. Using postal_city as the jurisdiction would have missed every Boston or San Diego local rule for these rows.
target_notes.zip_outside_state: Reviewed all 27 (NJ rows with NY, TX or CT ZIPs). No attempt matched outside NJ. 25 were matched by attempt A (street and city) and resolved, with the corrected NJ ZIP in the matched address. A0331 was matched by A and is review_required for its truncated suffix. A0343 was matched only by fallback C (ZIP omitted) and is review_required for a directional. Many other NJ rows have in-state but non-local ZIPs (e.g. Hoboken 07856); they matched the same way.
target_notes.fallback_attempt_C: A0338 (in-state but non-local ZIP 07417, no suffix) and A0343 matched only with the ZIP omitted. Both matches are inside Newark city.
target_notes.near_place_boundary:
Reviewed all 12. Each Census point lies inside the reported place, on the address range's side of the street. Within about 80 m there is a different jurisdiction:
- Somerville city: 5 North Cambridge rows (Oxford, Chester, Forest and Roseland St).
- West Hollywood city: A0067 and A0427.
- Oakland city: A0197.
- Brookline town: A0233, A0356 and A0362 (an MCD, not an incorporated place).
- No incorporated place west of A0165 (San Diego CCD).
No sample address is within about 80 m of the Hoboken-Jersey City line. Results unchanged; the flags are for M5 and T2.
